info.title: Demo Shop API
info.description: Every response is wrapped in an envelope: `{success, data, meta}` or `{success, error, meta}`. Errors list their stable `error.code` values per endpoint.

post.description: Self sign-up. Always creates a customer.

get.description: Public catalog. Managers and admins also see disabled products.

patch.description: Price changes apply to carts right away, orders keep the price they were placed with.

post.description: Adds to the quantity if the product is already in the cart. Stock is not reserved here.

put.description: One promo code per cart, a new one replaces the old one.

post.description: Creates an order from the cart and reserves stock. The order must be paid within the payment deadline.

get.description: Customers see their own orders, managers and admins see all. Newest first.

post.description: Before shipping only. A paid order is refunded. Stock goes back.

inStock.title: Instock
inStock.description: False if the product is disabled or stock is below quantity

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: False if the code no longer fits the cart (e.g. total dropped below minimum)

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every error, including validation errors, comes in this envelope.

correlationId.title: Correlationid
correlationId.description: Also sent as the X-Correlation-Id header

paymentDeadline.title: Paymentdeadline
paymentDeadline.description: Present only while status is created: UTC time without a timezone suffix, after which the order is cancelled

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Order with its status history and payments.

actorUuid.title: Actoruuid
actorUuid.description: Null when the system changed the status (payment timeout)
